caption: The drawing depicts two main objects: a bear standing on its hind legs at the left and a human figure on the right, who is kneeling with one knee on the ground. The bear is brown with green vines wrapped around its body and standing on a rock formation that is colored dark gray and green. Opposite the bear, the human figure is wearing a feathered headdress with yellow and brown feathers, a red long-sleeved shirt with yellow decorations on the sleeves, tan pants, and brown footwear. The figure has brown hair and is holding a large gray rifle, aiming it directly at the bear. The rifle is resting on the figure’s bent knee, and the individual appears to be in a shooting posture. Both figures are positioned on a green grassy base with darker green and yellow accents, which stretches horizontally beneath them. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color. The illustration is signed "Ethal Clark '39" in brown ink in the bottom right corner.
title: Toy Bank: Bear and Indian
